task025_raw_stages.result: all eight EXP-004 copy endpoints and four allocation-share medians reproduced after rounding
task025_raw_stages.method: Import the 40 profiled rank CSVs listed in inputs: slots 22/28 x pageable/pinned x measured runs 1..5 x ranks 0/1. Use iter 2..9. For each slot, variant, run, iter, direction and metric take max across ranks. Sum d2h_s or h2d_s over the 40 run/iter samples; a ratio of sums equals the ratio of means because counts are equal. Reduction=100*(1-pinned_sum/pageable_sum). For allocation-share per run, sum independently rank-maximized allocate_s and free_s across both directions/8 iterations, divide by sum of per-iteration rank-MAX total_s (not double-counted by direction), multiply by 100, then take the five-run median. Do not interpret sums of independently maximized stages as an exact critical path.

task025_decision_crosscheck.method: Inspect formal decision.json slots22/slots28/failed_gates and pairs.json stable8 fields/errors.

task020_csv_crosscheck.method: Directly inspect the five stored critical-path.csv rows and compare their ordered values/gate counts with ADR-006 and historical receipt. Did not execute or revalidate the old model auditor.

task007_allocation_share.method: Read raw task007-profile-timing-formal-1450272_3.out through _7.out. Retain header beginning solver, and data beginning penta,exp,. Parse CSV. For each independent job, compute 100 * mean(host_staging_allocate_s_max + host_staging_free_s_max) / mean(total_s_max) over its 10 exp rows. Median/max are across five jobs; iterations are not independent jobs.
